title: Hiring cards: clearer applicant review
lede: Stronger names and specialty hierarchy, readable experience summaries, and review controls separated from application details. Fictional candidates shown.

sections.heading: Same candidates, same viewport
sections.note: Baseline retains the prior uncommitted Hiring card implementation. Both captures use identical fixture data, shared CSS, browser settings and wrapper. Source snapshots are retained; this is presentation evidence, not an authenticated preview.

pairs.title: Hiring board
pairs.beforeCap: Dense tags, small summary text, and unlabeled material icons.
pairs.afterCap: Stronger name and specialty hierarchy, readable summaries, labeled materials, and a distinct review footer.

changes.was: Small name with truncation and every specialty competing as a badge.
changes.now: Wrapping semibold name, one primary specialty badge, and secondary areas as quieter text.

changes.was: Small summary text and unlabeled material icons.
changes.now: Three-line readable summary, labeled material indicators, direct source links, and rating count.

changes.was: Review control competed with plain source links in a compact card.
changes.now: Separate review footer with saving state, more column spacing, explicit empty columns, and local horizontal scrolling.

verification: 183 focused Hiring/Workforce tests and 11 CLI tests passed.
Keyboard opening and review toggle passed in the actual card fixture; no browser errors.
390 CSS-pixel mobile fixture: page width remained 390 pixels; card contents fit their containers.
Dark appearance and missing-data/long-name fixtures visually inspected.
Production data independently verified: 76 candidates, 55 Applied, 5 Round 1, 16 Passed; 1 Maybe note. Blank sheet decisions and review flags preserved.
notes: The card redesign is local and has not been committed, pushed or deployed.
The merged Workforce branch has no managed preview environment. Authenticated server proof of the changed UI remains pending.
Source snapshots and matching metadata are retained alongside this review. Mobile and dark captures are supplemental after-only evidence.
